title: Effective etale descent for polarized schemes
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\{U_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be a jointly surjective etale covering [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For each $i$ let $X_i\to U_i$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme] and let $L_i$ be an invertible module on $X_i$ [def-sc-invertible-module]. Suppose that on $U_i\times_S U_j$ [def-pc-fibre-product] there are isomorphisms $X_i\times_{U_i}(U_i\times_S U_j)\simeq X_j\times_{U_j}(U_i\times_S U_j)$ satisfying identity and cocycle conditions, and isomorphisms $\lambda_{ij}:\theta_{ij}^*L_j\xrightarrow{\sim}L_i$ on the corresponding scheme overlaps, where $\theta_{ij}$ denotes the specified scheme isomorphism. Require the identity condition for $\lambda_{ii}$ after restriction along the diagonal $U_i\to U_i\times_SU_i$, and the cocycle condition $\lambda_{ik}=\lambda_{ij}\circ\theta_{ij}^*\lambda_{jk}$ on every triple overlap, using $\theta_{jk}\circ\theta_{ij}=\theta_{ik}$ to identify their domains. Assume that for every affine open $V\subset U_i$, the restriction of $L_i$ to $X_i\times_{U_i}V$ is ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Then there exist a scheme $X\to S$ [def-pc-scheme] and an invertible module $L$ on $X$, with compatible isomorphisms $(X,L)\times_S U_i\simeq(X_i,L_i)$. The descended pair is unique up to unique compatible isomorphism.

proof.text: Use [lem-trf-polarized-scheme-charts] to obtain Y over S with chart isomorphisms over U_i inducing precisely theta. This step gives only the scheme, not its global ordinary module.

Apply [lem-trf-polarized-module-on-charts] on this fixed Y. Its invertible module, chart module isomorphisms and transition equations form a PolarizedDescentPair d with IsPolarizedDescentRealization D d.

For any candidate pair d, base change the covering U_i to d.Y and transport it through the chart isomorphisms. It is an fppf covering by [lem-trf-fppf-covering-base-change]. Representables are sheaves by [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-representable-descent] and fppfTopology_le_fpqcTopology. Thus chartMap_ext detects equality of arbitrary maps from d.Y, with no module hypotheses.

For two realizations d,d\prime, consider test maps a:T->X_i and b:T->X_j with equal images in d.Y. Their base images in S agree. The pullback lift r into the (i,j) overlap has first X coordinate a and second U coordinate f_j b. The theta equation of d shows that its transported X_j coordinate has the same Y coordinate as b, and theta_over_left gives the same U_j coordinate. These two coordinates determine an X_j map by the pullback chart, hence the transported coordinate equals b. The theta equation of d\prime now gives a q_i\prime=b q_j\prime. Representable-sheaf amalgamation therefore glues the chart maps uniquely to a:d.Y->d\prime.Y. This is the explicit Lean proof existsUnique_chartMap.

Repeat the scheme gluing with the realizations reversed. Both composites equal identities after every chart; chartMap_ext proves both inverse identities. The same chart test proves that the resulting scheme isomorphism is over S. These are categorical composition and pullback uniqueness calculations.

Apply [lem-trf-polarized-line-iso-descent] to the fixed scheme isomorphism to obtain its unique compatible line isomorphism, forming the required pair isomorphism. For any other pair isomorphism, scheme gluing uniqueness first identifies its scheme component. After substituting that equality, module uniqueness identifies its module component. The remaining fields are proofs and agree by proof irrelevance.

proof_origin.place: B7: polarized effectivity split into scheme charts and module effectivity; Tag 023Q is implemented directly for scheme maps with an explicit overlap lift; Tag 023T supplies the remaining module-isomorphism bridge. Spaces Tags 02WW/02WV and Spaces Descent Tags 04W8/0D3C remain in the chart-effectivity subproblem.
